capture_quality.capture_drop_counts: not stored in pcap; inspect collector stderr separately

retained_outputs.selection: Every valid packet with a wanted direction/identity, including all duplicate records. Original global and packet headers and captured bytes are preserved.

send.counter_note: last recorded snapshot; may precede final packet

receive.counter_note: last recorded snapshot; may precede final packet

interpretation.residual: Sum of Linux software TX to macOS BPF RX, and macOS BPF TX to Linux software RX. Includes NIC/driver/network work; not wire-only or one-way latency.
interpretation.clock: BPF turnaround uses two macOS host-clock timestamps; all other terms use Linux-local differences. Constant host epoch offsets cancel. Clock steps within a cycle do not cancel; inspect calibration and negative values.
interpretation.cohorts: Complete is a subset of partial, which is a subset of turnaround. Every correction comes from the same identified cycle. Missing TX stamps are never replaced by other samples or cohort medians.
interpretation.selection: Complete measurement ProbeRTT intervals, with first/last 2 ms excluded. Data and ACK must match the same steady probe. Identity ambiguity rejects all candidates.
interpretation.sampling: size-class-v2 selects all payloads shorter than 256 bytes and about 1/16 larger payloads. This is size-based sampling, not proof that every short packet contains an ACK. Only parsed ACK-frame links enter cycles.
interpretation.negative_values: Retained and counted in distributions; inspect timing semantics and clocks before interpretation.

send.clock: monotime; Unix anchor is a sequential observation, never cross-host one-way time

receive.clock: monotime; Unix anchor is a sequential observation, never cross-host one-way time
